description: DJI Matrice 100 / TB47D reference with 500 g payload, plus a separately modelled Intel 5300 radio. Not a measured assembled UAV or a 5G NR radio.

sources.title: DJI Matrice 100 specifications, standard TB47D battery
sources.used_for: Published 99.9 Wh, 4500 mAh, 22.2 V, 17 min hover with 500 g payload.

sources.title: DJI Matrice 100 User Manual V1.0, printed pages 69-71 (DJI-authored mirrored manual)
sources.used_for: Hover-time conditions: no wind, 10 m above sea level, landing at 10% battery.

sources.title: D. Halperin, B. Greenstein, A. Sheth, D. Wetherall, Demystifying 802.11n Power Consumption, HotPower 2010, Table 3
sources.used_for: Intel 5300 measured state powers: idle 0.82 W, single-stream TX 1.28 W, one-antenna SISO RX 0.94 W. Paper considers per-stream rates 6.5-65 Mbps.

derivation.aircraft_baseline_w: Assume linear usable nominal energy: 0.90 * 359640 / (17 * 60) = 317.32941176470587 W. Effective aircraft baseline includes original onboard electronics; not pure propulsion.
derivation.payload: 500 g is the selected reference loading condition, not our measured computer/radio payload mass or power.
derivation.extra_radio: Hypothetical additional NIC. Its 0.82 W is added to the aircraft baseline; do not add a second platform/hover term. No host-computer power increment is provided by these sources.
derivation.phy_rate: 65e6 bit/s is a selected reference mode, not a measured link rate and not the tc 5 Mbps shaper.
derivation.incremental_coefficients: TX=(1.28-0.82)/65e6 J/bit; RX=(0.94-0.82)/65e6 J/bit. Idle is charged once. Serialization-only workload proxy: no wireless preamble/ACK/retry/contention accounting.
derivation.battery_fraction: f(t)=max(0, f(0)-E_used(t)/C_nominal). State of charge is a linear model, not battery telemetry.
